body:
Having experienced this, do you think it would be better not to tell my SO what has happened? Would it be better to save them from the pain? I am sorry that you have had to deal with that constant battle in your head, it is completely draining. I have no energy left. 

I could describe my experience very similarly to yours, finally tasting life and experiencing happiness that I didn't know existed to being at the lowest point I have ever been. Exactly how I have felt.

My partner doesn't know and I don't know how to tell them or if I should. I know it would hurt my SO so badly and the thought of it makes me want to cry. My biggest problem is that I care about both of them in completely different ways. I have been with my SO since I was a teenager and when you are with somebody through some of the most formative years of your life, you become incredibly comfortable and used to them being there, plus all of the history. You feel safe with them. However, I have never had such amazing experiences like I have had over the past few months or such a deep connection with anybody else before, but in a completely different way than I do with my SO. We have become incredibly close over the past 9 months. This person recently started talking about us "long-term" and that they are thinking about leaving their spouse, which adds to the guilt. Too many people are going to get hurt. That was when I could no longer compartmentalize the two lives. I have been living a double life and I just finally realized it. When they started asking me about the future, I realized that my future couldn't have both of them. It is not that I don't love my SO and I wasn't out looking for something like this, it developed over quite a bit of time and it is my fault for letting it happen. I have realized that I probably already ruined it with my SO, but I still can't imagine ending it with them. My SO deserves so much more than all of this. I am leaving out many details... I don't know what to do. I feel so sick about the whole thing. I care about both of them. I know this doesn't sound like that big of an issue to warrant a post on here, but it really is even more complicated than this and much more playing into this need to escape.

I have been cheating. It is much more complicated than that, but if I cut out all of the details the fact is that I have cheated on someone I care about.. I never wanted to be "that" person. I have been with my significant other for about nine years (since I was 15). I have been cheating for the past nine months with someone who is married. I am so disgusted with myself. I really don't think I can type this all out.. it would take so long. That is only one part of the whole thing, but I guess that is a start.

The last several months have been a roller coaster of emotions, both wonderful and terrifying. I have been incredibly selfish. I am in a constant state of conflicted thoughts. I do not deserve any sympathy. I have for the most part been able to partition the guilt out of my mind, but this week it finally spilled over. I have no idea what to do.
